proposals.title: Honest filter help matching {{field}} expression dialect
proposals.summary: analysis/filter.md still documents a bare SQL-style example (`status = 'needs-repair'`) and points authors at map-editing Filters for syntax. filterGenerator compiles via the shared expression dialect, which requires double-brace field refs (`{{status}} = 'needs-repair'`). Rewrite filter.md Inputs/Examples/Notes to match expression-language.md and the Calculate honesty pattern; keep the map-filter vs derived-layer distinction.
proposals.rationale: Same class of analysis help lie as calculate/spatial-join in cycle 8. Authors who paste bare field names from the page into a Filter step get validate failures.
proposals.risk: Do not invent a second dialect. Cross-link reference/expression-language; keep map-editing/filters.md as the map-layer surface (also {{field}} per expression-language); CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about the free expression dialect. One vocabulary, documented correctly.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite filter.md to {{field}} examples + expression-language link; drop bare-name SQL cosplay; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest spatial-filter help matching predicates + otherSource
proposals.summary: spatialFilterGenerator ships intersects / within / contains / touches / near(+distanceMeters) with otherSource data_layer or inline-geometry. spatial-join.md already points authors at a separate spatial-filter step, but there is no analysis/spatial-filter.md. Add help matching SpatialFilterStepEditor and the generator; say left rows pass through unchanged (no attribute join, no row multiply).
proposals.rationale: Highest-visibility missing analysis help after filter honesty. Demo authors following the spatial-join cross-link hit a dead end.
proposals.risk: Do not invent cartesian joins or attribute projection. Document near distance in meters; note ACL on otherSource (SEC-otherSource-acl); CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new unless Analyze shortcut lands later.
proposals.ethosFit: Document the free PostGIS spatial WHERE you actually get. Prefer OGC predicates over fake Esri Select Layer By Location parity.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add help/analysis/spatial-filter.md (predicates + otherSource + near meters); cross-link from spatial-join; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest help for top-n, random-sample, and nearest-neighbor
proposals.summary: top-n / random-sample / nearest-neighbor generators and builder editors ship; python-client lists them; there are no analysis help pages. Document: top-n (numeric field + n + asc|desc, NULLs last); random-sample (percentage|count + stable seed); nearest-neighbor (no-param nearest_distance_m via geography self-join, O(N^2) honesty, single-row NULL).
proposals.rationale: Closing the remaining generator-without-help honesty gap for attribute/sampling tools before more Analyze chrome. Authors discover these only in the builder or Python client today.
proposals.risk: Do not invent KNN index requirements or shuffle UI. Say nearest-neighbor is same-layer distance only (not a second layer); keep featureLimit / MAX_N / MAX_COUNT caps visible; CHANGELOG docs note.
proposals.ethosFit: Docs match the free PostGIS sampling / proximity tools you actually get.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add help/analysis/top-n.md, random-sample.md, nearest-neighbor.md matching generators; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Honest derived-layer item help: full step catalog + Analyze list
proposals.summary: items/derived-layer.md Pipeline model still lists a partial step set (Filter, singular Calculate, Buffer, Spatial join, Group by, Dissolve, Simplify, Centroid, Fishnet, Contour, Clip) and omits Erase, Densify, Convex hull, Calculate geometry, Bbox, Vertices, Top-N, Random sample, Nearest neighbor, Spatial filter. Analyze blurb also lags shipped shortcuts. Expand the catalog to match registry.ts + builder; keep one short line per tool with links where help exists.
proposals.rationale: Item-type help is the first page authors read. An incomplete catalog is a silent lie after R6–R8 tool growth.
proposals.risk: Keep the page a catalog, not a second copy of every tool page. Prefer links into analysis/*; CHANGELOG docs note; skip What's new.
proposals.ethosFit: Honest about what derived layers can run today. No fake ModelBuilder palette.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Rewrite derived-layer.md Analyze blurb + step list to match registry/builder; link existing analysis help; CHANGELOG docs note.

proposals.title: Continue #162 i18n on field collect / GPS / remove chrome
proposals.summary: Field PWA Add-feature sheet and More-menu status chrome already go through fieldRuntime / fieldOffline catalogs (R6). field-runtime.tsx still hard-codes English on collect actions (Add at GPS / Add at center / Vertex at …), view-only editable hint, Remove from device label, and several aria-labels (Toggle layers, Search address, Zoom in/out, Reset bearing, Pick lists). Extract into fieldCollect / fieldRuntime catalogs with t() calls. No Weblate, no RTL.
proposals.rationale: Only finishable open-issue slice left after Analyze query-builder i18n. Field collectors are the #162 audience (EU / LatAm demos).
proposals.risk: Keep offlineMessage progress codes as-is. Reuse existing fieldRuntime / fieldCollect / fieldGps / fieldOffline keys where possible; machine-translate non-en with the Phase 1.1 pattern. Scope to user-visible collect/chrome strings, not the whole 6k-line runtime.
proposals.ethosFit: Language follow-through on free field chrome. No Contour brand kit.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Extract remaining field collect / GPS / remove / map-chrome strings into en/es/fr/de/pt-BR catalogs with t() calls; What's new optional (i18n-only can skip).

proposals.title: Guided Bounding boxes shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: bboxGenerator is no-param like centroid (ST_Envelope per feature, attributes pass through). Analyze has no Bounding boxes for this layer control and help has no bbox.md. Mirror AnalyzeCentroidGuide: POST a single-step bbox derived_layer, label as server job, add help/analysis/bbox.md.
proposals.rationale: Cheapest remaining Analyze honesty win after Convex hull. Extent rectangles are a common free substitute for heavy geometry in clustering / overview maps.
proposals.risk: Users may expect one envelope for the whole layer. Generator is per-feature envelope; say so in UI and help. Reuse Centroid worker path and i18n pattern.
proposals.ethosFit: Free-at-point-of-use analysis on your hardware. Guided PostGIS over proprietary geoprocessing seats.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-bbox-guide POSTing single-step bbox derived_layer; add help/analysis/bbox.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Vertices shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: verticesGenerator is no-param (ST_DumpPoints + vertex_index). Analyze has no Vertices for this layer control and help has no vertices.md. Mirror AnalyzeCentroidGuide: POST single-step vertices derived_layer; document row explosion and MULTI* expansion honesty.
proposals.rationale: Next no-param Analyze shortcut after bbox. Corners / densify-prep workflows map onto free PostGIS without a desktop seat.
proposals.risk: Output row count can explode on dense polygons. Say so in UI/help; reuse existing featureLimit path; do not invent a sample-every-Nth control in this PR.
proposals.ethosFit: Free vertex explode on your PostGIS. Honest about MULTI* dump behavior.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-vertices-guide + help/analysis/vertices.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.

proposals.title: Guided Calculate geometry shortcut that creates a derived-layer recipe
proposals.summary: calculateGeometryGenerator already takes measurement + unit + fieldName (Buffer-shaped). Analyze has no Calculate geometry for this layer control; calculate.md documents the builder path only. Mirror AnalyzeSimplifyGuide / Densify: short form (measurement, unit, field name), POST single-step calculate-geometry derived_layer, label as server job.
proposals.rationale: Next parameterized Analyze shortcut after Densify. Meter-honest length / perimeter / area on PostGIS without inventing expression helpers (pairs with R8 calculate honesty).
proposals.risk: Unit confusion (length vs area units). Reuse Buffer unit conversion honesty; reject reserved field names in the form; keep Calculate field as a separate builder-only path (expression), not this shortcut.
proposals.ethosFit: Free geometry measures on your PostGIS. Prefer honest units over degree traps and fake area_m2() expressions.
proposals.suggestedFirstPR: Add analyze-calculate-geometry-guide; link calculate.md; What's new + CHANGELOG + locale catalogs.
